blocks.title: Algorithm analysis
blocks.text: Algorithm analysis kisi algorithm ki computational complexity, yaani waqt aur jagah ki complexity, maloom karta hai ta ke kaarkardagi ka andaza lagaya ja sake aur kaam ke liye behtareen algorithm chuna ja sake.

blocks.prompt: Algorithm analysis kaunse do wasail naapta hai?

items: Algorithm analysis: waqt aur jagah ki complexity, algorithms ke muwazne aur intikhab ke liye.
